name: Trossingen (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided blue over yellow, charged at the centre with the city arms of Trossingen (a black eagle on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Trossingen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Trossingen arms — black eagle on yellow
